idea: Test candidate multisets of sides for packability with Korf/Huang–Korf's two-phase rectangle-packing algorithm. First assign x-intervals with cumulative-width (wasted-space) pruning, then solve the y-placement as a separate CSP. Order squares in decreasing size and break symmetry by restricting the largest square to one quadrant. This is typically far faster than skyline backtracking, so many more knapsack multisets can be certified.
